Bowen Byram isn't available for tomorrow's game. Andrew Mangiapane and Kevin Korchinski are expected to play. 

Jeff Blashill didn't say much on Moore's likely healthy scratch. Reading between the lines, Moore's offensive zone turnover leading to the Canadiens' first goal didn't help his standing.

My latest article for @thehockeynews is about the goaltender market now that the biggest domino has fallen. Where does that leave the Canadiens? thehockeynews.com/nhl/montreal... #GoHabsGo #CH #Habs #Canadiens #THN
Without two of their top talents, the Canadiens will have to dig in on what they’ve prioritized for six weeks. It could be a blessing in disguise. www.nytimes.com/athletic/771...

The Canadiens defeat the Blackhawks, 4-1. Blackhawks fall to 3-7-0 on the season.
Danault wins the faceoff and Matheson gets the empty netter 4-1 Montreal #goHabsGo
Terravainen helps the Habs, creating interference against Jake Evans, end of the PP and breathe Habs fans #GoHabsGo
With 6:14 to go, Slafkovsky gets a holding call...you can't give the refs the opportunity to make that call. #goHabsGo

Jake Evans saw the Bat-signal when Nick Suzuki was injured and stepped up, three points as the Canadiens have a (dreaded) two-goal lead headed into the third. Have they learned from their mistake yet? 3-1 Montreal after 40 minutes #GoHabsGo
3-1 Montreal as Kaiden Guhhle finds the back of the net, Evans with an assist. #goHabsGo
Canadiens take a 3-1 lead on a long shot from the blue line by Kaiden Guhle. The Blackhawks have them right where they want them.
The Hawks will head to the box after stopping Beck from shooting, can Montreal capitalize? #GoHabsGo
2 on 1 well-played by Hutson who cut the pass possibility, leaving Fowler to make an easy save and control the rebound #goHabsGo
Evans doubles down, it's a shorty, 2-1 Montreal #GoHabsGo
